note: Male narration by default. Any en-US male voice works: pass --voice. Title is the on-screen step chip; caption is the burned subtitle; focus is the element the highlight ring is drawn around.

scenes.title: Your dashboard starts in Demo Mode
scenes.caption: You start in Demo Mode with $1,000 of virtual funds.
scenes.say: This is your Arbitrix dashboard. You start in Demo Mode, with one thousand dollars of virtual funds, so you can practise the whole platform without risking any money.

scenes.title: Switch to Live Mode
scenes.caption: Live Mode uses real funds - only the Live balance can be traded or withdrawn.
scenes.say: When you are ready, switch to Live Mode. Live uses real funds, and only your Live balance can be traded and withdrawn.

scenes.title: Open the deposit window
scenes.caption: Open the deposit window. The minimum deposit is $100.
scenes.say: To fund your Live balance, open the deposit window. The minimum deposit is one hundred US dollars.

scenes.title: Enter the amount
scenes.caption: Enter the amount you want to deposit, then press Generate Payment.
scenes.say: Enter the amount you want to deposit, then press Generate Payment. Arbitrix creates a unique payment address for that exact amount.

scenes.title: Send USDT on TRON (TRC20)
scenes.caption: Send USDT on TRON (TRC20) to this address, for the exact amount shown.
scenes.say: Send USDT on the TRON network, T R C twenty, to this address. Use the exact amount shown, and scan the QR code if your wallet supports it. Sending on another network can lose your funds.

scenes.title: Wait for the confirmation
scenes.caption: Arbitrix watches the blockchain: the status moves to credited after confirmation.
scenes.say: Arbitrix watches the blockchain for you. The status moves from waiting, to detected, to credited, usually a few minutes after the first confirmation.

scenes.title: Your Live balance is funded
scenes.caption: The funds are in your Live balance, ready to trade.
scenes.say: The funds are now in your Live balance. From here you can start automated trading, and you can always see the balance on your dashboard.

scenes.title: Help is one message away
scenes.caption: Questions? Message the Arbitrix support team any time.
scenes.say: If anything is unclear, our support team is one message away, at t dot me slash Arbitrix Support Bot.
